scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Our Alchemist Union brings up many junior alchemists with various promotions and investigations.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
炼金术士公会通过各项推广和调查活动，培养了许多年轻的炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
- You still have unused skill points. Come back when you have used all of them. -
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
- 你还有未使用的技能点。请在使用完所有技能点后再回来。-

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
The infamous Geneticist is studying at the Alchemy Lab in the western part of Lighthalzen.
If you are interested, go meet with her.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
那位恶名在外的基因学者，就在里希塔乐镇西部的炼金实验室做研究。
有兴趣的话，可以去见见她。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
They have spread to all corners of Midgard and were active in many fields like sciences or special item production methods.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
他们遍布米德加尔特，活跃于科学研究、特殊物品制作等各个领域。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
We call the members of our new union ^3131FF'Geneticists'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
我们将新公会的成员称为^3131FF“基因学者”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Geneticists are the ones who have reached their peak potential in the world of Alchemy. They are the ones who currently spearhead alchemy throughout all of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
基因学者在炼金术领域的造诣已臻巅峰，如今正引领整个米德加尔特的炼金术发展。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
It looks like you are an expert in this field, how about meeting other geneticists?
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
看来你是这方面的专家，要不要去见见其他基因学者？

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Not long ago there was a Geneticist who announced a sensational new life studying research.
You are very knowledgeable. Do you think you might understand her work?
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
不久前，有一位基因学者宣布了一项关于生命研究的轰动性新发现。
你学识渊博，觉得能理解她的研究吗？

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Her study may help you gain the knowledge to help you make a Geneticist!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
她的研究或许能帮助你获得知识，从而成为基因学者！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
How's that sound? Do you want to meet a Geneticist?
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
听起来如何？你想见见基因学者吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I want to meet a Geneticist.
scripts.translation: 当然，我想见见基因学者

scripts.text: I don't want to meet a Geneticist.
scripts.translation: 我不想见基因学者

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Access to Premium content is only available to those who possess a certain amount of Reset Stones.
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声音]
只有持有足够重置石的人，才能体验高级内容。

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Would you like to participate in this quest for 1 ^0000CCReset Stone^000000?
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声音]
您愿意使用1颗^0000CC重置石^000000参与这个任务吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Good luck, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声音]
祝您好运，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
In order to change to third class, you must bring 1 ^0000CCReset Stone^000000 or have a Premium account.
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声音]
要进行三转，您必须携带1颗^0000CC重置石^000000，或拥有高级账号。

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Very well.
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声音]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Wise choice!
The infamous Geneticist 'Devries'.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
明智！她就是那位恶名在外的基因学者，德弗里斯。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
You can find her in the Alchemy Lab at the western part of Lighthalzen. There is also another Geneticist studying weaponry there, you might want to pay her a visit as well.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
你可以在里希塔乐镇西部的炼金实验室找到她。那里还有一位研究武器的基因学者，你也可以顺便去拜访一下。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Aren't you interested in the study of life?
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
你对生命研究不感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
They have spread to all corners of Midgard and were active in many fields like sciences or special item production methods.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
他们遍布米德加尔特，活跃于科学研究、特殊物品制作等各个领域。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
We call the members of our new union ^3131FF'Geneticists'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
我们将新公会的成员称为^3131FF“基因学者”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Union Member]
Geneticists are the ones who have reached their peak potential in the world of Alchemy. They are the ones who currently spearhead alchemy throughout all of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
基因学者在炼金术领域的造诣已臻巅峰，如今正引领整个米德加尔特的炼金术发展。

scripts.text: - You still have some unused skill points. -
scripts.translation: - 你还有未使用的技能点。-

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Oh! The bloodsucking plant sample C is withering again.
Should I change the ingredient of the growth care?
Hey please cheer up soon!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哎呀！吸血植物C号样本又蔫了。
得换换生长护理剂的配方吗？
喂，快打起精神来啊！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Oh? A stranger?
Your look tells me that you are doing Alchemy as well right?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哦？是个陌生人？
看你的样子，应该也在研究炼金术吧？

scripts.text:
[Devries]
People say the number of alchemists is increasing nowadays though there aren't may who study this field properly!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
人们说现在炼金术士的数量在增加，但真正深入研究这个领域的人并不多！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
They're all too worried about saying things like, ''Look at my bomb damage!'' or ''isn?t my homunculus prettier?''
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
成天只会嚷嚷“看我的炸弹伤害！”“我的生命体是不是更漂亮？”

scripts.text:
[Devries]
The Alchemist Union was saying they'd support the researchers but actually what you get from the studying is just 'Spores Which Can Be Easily Raised'!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
炼金术士公会说他们会支持研究员，但实际上你从研究中得到的只是“容易培育的魔菇”！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Thanks to that, there are spores everywhere in my lab! There are spores everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
多亏了它们，我的实验室里到处都是魔菇！到处都是魔菇！

scripts.text: Why do you talk like that?
scripts.translation: 你为什么那样说话？

scripts.text:
[Devries]
'Cause I'm from Rune-Midgarts!
Have you ever been to Rune-Midgarts? Everyone in Rune-Midgarts speaks like this.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
因为我是来自卢恩·米德加兹的！
你去过卢恩·米德加兹吗？那里的人都这样说话。

scripts.text: Impossible?!
scripts.translation: 不可能？！

scripts.text: I'm also from Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 我也来自卢恩·米德加兹

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Impossible?
Do you come from a Rune-Midgarts village?
My village is very big, everyone there speaks like this.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
不可能？
你来自卢恩·米德加兹的村庄吗？
我的村庄很大，那里的人都这样说话。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Really! That's why I felt some kind of familiar atmosphere around you.
Meeting a hometown person in Schwarzwald, it's my pleasure to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
真的！所以我觉得你身上有一种熟悉的气息。
在秀发兹发德遇到老乡，很高兴见到你！

scripts.text: - Thump!! -

[Devries]
Ughhhhh! That woman started again!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
呜哇！那个女人又开始了！

scripts.text: What's that sound?
scripts.translation: 那是什么声音？

scripts.text:
[Devries]
That's the sound of an experiment being carried out by my roommate, Demi Calberine..
Demi's a fire shell technician so she's always noisy like that.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
我室友黛米·卡尔贝林又在做实验。
她是弹药技师，天天都这么吵。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Look at that!
My spores and plants are all freaked out!
I can't do my work with those noisy sounds. It gives me so much stress!!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
看那些！
我的魔菇和植物都被吓坏了！
在这种噪音下我无法工作，太有压力了！！

scripts.text: - Munch Crunch -
scripts.translation: - 咔嚓 咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Devries]
When I don't feel good, I savor Mr. Orlean's handmade cookies little by little.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
心情不好的时候，就得慢慢品尝奥尔良先生手工做的饼干。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
It's a high-quality cookie that I got from Prontera. When I get one bite, it seems like I'm floating to Asgard.
The softness of the sweet cookie drowns out the clashing sounds from Demi Calberine.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
那可是从普隆德拉买来的高级饼干，咬一口，就像飘到了阿斯加德。
香甜酥软的滋味，能把黛米·卡尔贝林那些叮当声都盖过去。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Wanna try one?
Ah, I've eaten all of it.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
想尝尝吗？
啊，我都吃完了。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
But it's okay! On the 2nd floor of my room, there are boxes of those!
I couldn't stop buying it all in bulk. Ho ho ho.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
不过没关系！楼上还囤着好几箱呢！
一买就忍不住整批买，呵呵呵。

scripts.text: - Zooooooooooooooooing -

- (Screeching Sounds)!!! -
- (Screeching)!!! -
- Bump! Bump! Bump! -

scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Yoooooooooooow
Yipeeeeeeeeee!!!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
呀啊啊——
咿呀啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Demiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!!
Demiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!!

- For now it seems that I -
- need to calm down Devries. -
scripts.translation: - 得先想办法让德弗里斯冷静下来。-

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Yipeeeeeeeeee!!!
Demiiiiii!!!
Demiiiiiiiii!!!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
咿呀啊啊！！！
黛米——！！！
黛米————！！！

scripts.text:
- Hmm. -
- What'll make her calm? -
scripts.translation:
- 嗯。-
- 什么能让她冷静下来呢？-

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Yipeeeeeeeeee!!!
Demiiiiii!!!
Demiiiiiiiii!!!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
咿呀啊啊！！！
黛米——！！！
黛米————！！！

scripts.text: Hand Devries a cookie.
scripts.translation: 递给德弗里斯一块饼干

scripts.text:
- Devries quickly snatches -
- away the cookie and stuffs -
- it all in her mouth. -
scripts.translation: - 德弗里斯一把抢过饼干，整个塞进嘴里。-

scripts.text:
- Crunch Crunch Crunch -
- Crunch Crunch Crunch -
- Crunch Crunch Crunch -
scripts.translation:
- 咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓 -
- 咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓 -
- 咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Ah, The sweet buttery taste remains at the end of my tongue.
This really gives me peace of mind.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
啊，甜美的黄油味道在舌尖萦绕。
这真的让我心情平静了下来。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Demi is studying hard today as well
Huhuhu. She's really a hard worker.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
黛米今天也在努力学习呢。
呵呵呵。她真的很努力。

scripts.text: - That cookie changed her mood quick. -
scripts.translation: - 那块饼干很快改变了她的心情。-

scripts.text:
[Devries]
You came here with a love for Alchemy?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
你是怀着对炼金术的热爱来到这里的吗？

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Oh wait, We haven't introduced ourselves yet.
My name is Devries.
I'm very interested in making living things that show new and peculiar growth.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哦等等，我们还没自我介绍呢。
我叫德弗里斯。
我对培育出展现新奇且独特生长形态的生命体非常感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
What's your name, young alchemist?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
你叫什么名字，年轻的炼金术士？
我是{0}

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Oh, {0}!
That's a very unusual name. Pleased to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哦，{0}！
真是个不寻常的名字。很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
But I can't memorize the name well.
So I'll just call you <Popo>. Would that be ok?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
但我记不太住这个名字。
所以我还是叫你<波波>吧。可以吗？

scripts.text: I uhh...

[Devries]
Great...
Popo, have you heard of my research?
You came here because of that, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
太好了...
波波，你听说过我的研究吗？
你就是因为那个才来的，对吧？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Well, it's all over your face.
You don't have to be shy.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
嗯，这都写在你的脸上了。
不用害羞。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
That's right huh?
Well, as I expected, there really is something that makes homeland people get each other
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
果然吧？
我就知道，老乡之间就是心有灵犀。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
When you saw me in that feverish state, you remembered what I said before and that calmed me down.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
看我那么激动，你还记得我之前说的话，知道用饼干让我平静下来。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
I like the way you manage yourself and take care to remember small details.
You have the talent to become a Geneticist.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
你处事稳妥，连小细节都留意到了，我很欣赏。
有成为基因学者的天分！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
^FF0000If you become a Geneticist, you can't take the Alchemist's or Biochemist study course that you haven't investigated before.^000000
If that's all right for you, how about giving it a shot right now?.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
^FF0000转职为基因学者后，就无法再学习之前尚未研修的炼金术士、创造者课程。^000000
如果没问题，要不要现在试试？

scripts.text: I'll try later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再试

scripts.text: I want to become a Geneticist!
scripts.translation: 我想成为基因学者！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Alright.
Even though your knowledge is not that great as that of Geneticists, a fundamental knowledge is also important.
Popo, come back to me once you've finished your studies.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
好的。
虽然你的知识不如基因学者那样渊博，但基础知识也很重要。
波波，学完后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Good!
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
很好！
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Popo!
Are you ready to give it a shot?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
波波！
准备好尝试了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
You have to do your best! There is no easy way when looking for knowledge!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
你必须全力以赴！寻找知识没有捷径！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Very good!
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
非常好！
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
What do you think of plants, Popo
Do you like plants? What kind of plants are you interested in?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
波波，你觉得植物怎么样？
你喜欢植物吗？你对哪种植物感兴趣？

scripts.text: - Boom, Boom, Boom -
scripts.translation: - 轰，轰，轰 -

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Ah, please tell me Demi Calberine is not starting again?
Please let my expectation be wrong ... Please... Demi, please...
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
啊，不会吧，黛米·卡尔贝林又来了？
千万别让我猜中...拜托...黛米，拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Where did I stop talking
Oh, right. Plants are very important in Alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
我刚才说到哪了？
哦，对了。植物在炼金术中非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Alchemy can make Flora's and Geographers grow immensely fast, so they can help in battle, like those Alchemists...
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
炼金术能让噬人花、邪恶向日葵迅速生长，帮助战斗，就像那些炼金术士...

scripts.text: - Boom!! Boom!! Boom!! Boom!! -

scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Techniques, plants are relatively easy to...
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
技术方面，植物相对容易...

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Crossbreed...
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
杂交...

scripts.text:
- Pop!!!!!! -
- Keeeeeeeeeeeeeh!!!! -
- Boooooooooooooom!!!! -
- Boom!! Boom!! Boom!! -

scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Popo.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
波波。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
I'll give you the test to become a Geneticist.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
我会给你一份成为基因学者的测试。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
The subject is <The Perfect Soundproof System>!
Please think of a way to save me from Demi Calberine's noise, using plants and experimental equipment that are here on the 1st floor of the lab.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
题目是<完美的隔音系统>！
请利用实验室一楼的植物和实验设备，想出一种方法，让我免受黛米·卡尔贝林噪音的困扰。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Well, you better get started!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
好了，你最好快点开始！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
The subject is <The Perfect Soundproof System>!
Please think of a way to save me from Demi Calbereine's noise, using plants and experimental equipment that are here on the 1st floor of the lab.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
题目是<完美的隔音系统>！
请利用实验室一楼的植物和实验设备，想出一种方法，让我免受黛米·卡尔贝林噪音的困扰。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
There are some guides in the cabinet that you may use.
Well, you better get started!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
柜子里有一些指南，你可以参考一下。
好了，你最好快点开始！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Is there a problem?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: The experiment failed.
scripts.translation: 实验失败了

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Better get started, or I'll start to scream!!!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
快点开始，不然我就要尖叫了！！！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
You can start from the beginning then?
Why are you asking me such things?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
那就从头再来啊？
这还用问我吗？

scripts.text: - Zing Zing Zigi Zigi -
scripts.translation: - 叮叮 叮叮 叮叮叮 -

scripts.text: - Zing Zing Zigi Zigi -
scripts.translation: - 叮叮 叮叮 叮叮叮 -

scripts.text:
[Devries]
What the hell is Demi Calberine doing?
That's really a noisy one.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
黛米·卡尔贝林到底在干什么？
这噪音真的太大了。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Your study is done, Popo?
Give me those seeds.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
研究做完了，波波？
把种子给我。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
What happened?
How could you say the study is completed without any result?
Start again.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
发生什么事了？
怎么没有任何结果就说研究完成了？
重新开始。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Well, I'll take a look at the seeds Popo made.
What's the result?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
来看看波波培育的种子吧，效果怎么样呢？

scripts.text:
[Devries]
When you put a seed in a Super Cultivator, and adjust the temperature...
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
把种子放进超级培养器，调好温度...

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Damn!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
该死！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Popo, look at that!
That's really a mysterious plant!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
波波，快看那个！
那真是一种神秘的植物！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
The inside of the Cultivator is now full of thorny stems!
It's as if the stems are making a wall and growing very sturdily and those are getting tangled!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
培养器里长满了带刺的茎！
粗壮的茎彼此缠绕，简直像筑起了一堵墙！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
This is it, Popo!
This plant's properties can be used for many applications!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
就是这个，波波！
这种植物的特性可以应用于很多领域！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
This is really great, Popo.
I knew that you were knowledgeable but your ability is more than that!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
这真是太棒了，波波。
我知道你很博学，但你的能力远超于此！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
I will tell the outcome to the Alchemist Union.
I will send a recommendation letter saying that your ability is really great and that you could be a brilliant member.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
我会把成果报给炼金术士公会，再附上一封推荐信。
凭你的能力，一定能成为出色的成员。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Getting an answer from the Union will take some time, so could you wait a moment?
Why don't you go up to Demi Calberine?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
收到公会的回复需要一些时间，你能稍等一下吗？
为什么不去找黛米·卡尔贝林呢？

scripts.text:
[Devries]
She is a fellow Geneticist, specializing in mini cannons.
Go take a look at her experiment results.
Could you give this message to her? Tell her to conduct her experiments quietly.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
她也是一位基因学者，专门研究微型火炮。
去看看她的实验结果吧。
能把这条消息转告给她吗？告诉她做实验时安静一点。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Uh oh! You failed, Popo.
It didn't grow at all, it's withered already.
Go and start over!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哎呀！你失败了，波波。
它完全没长出来，已经枯萎了。
去重新开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Oh, wait a second.
It seems that the mail's has arrived.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哦，等一下。
看来信件到了。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
You can take a look at the Demi Calberine's work place while we get an answer from the Union.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
在等待公会回复期间，你可以去看看黛米·卡尔贝林的工作室。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Popo!
I've got good news for you!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
波波！
我有好消息要告诉你！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！-
- 你携带的物品太多，请减轻负重后再试。-

scripts.text:
[Devries]
A letter has arrived from the Alchemist Union.
I'll read it to you, Popo!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
炼金术士公会的信到了，波波，我念给你听！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Oh, it looks like you're not ready to hear it.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
哦，看来你还没准备好听。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
First take off that heavy and dirty cart, that doesn't suit you on this happy moment.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
先把那辆又重又脏的手推车卸了吧，大喜的日子，可不搭调。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
But you look like you have a lingering desire for previous studies.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
不过，你看起来对之前的研究还念念不忘。

scripts.text:
<Dearest Miss Devries,>
<We are very aware of the brilliant activities you've shown lately.>
scripts.translation:
<亲爱的德弗里斯小姐，>
<我们非常清楚你最近展现出的卓越成就。>

scripts.text:
<Miss. Devries>
This guy is also from my hometown.
scripts.translation:
<德弗里斯小姐>
这家伙也是我的老乡。

scripts.text:
<I heard very good news that your research results are taking the step of commercial use.>
<I'm sure it will be a great inspiration for other Alchemists.>
scripts.translation:
<我听到一个很好的消息，你的研究成果正在迈向商业化应用。>
<我相信这将成为其他炼金术士的灵感来源。>

scripts.text:
<Come to think of it, you've attached a paper?>
<It was a new plant which makes plants grow super-fast, discovered by an Alchemist named, {0}>
scripts.translation:
<你还附了一篇论文，对吧？>
<一位名叫{0}的炼金术士，发现了能让植物飞速生长的新植物。>

scripts.text: <Myself and many other Alchemists from the Alchemist union are taking great interest in this.>
scripts.translation: <我和炼金术士公会的许多其他炼金术士都对它很感兴趣。>

scripts.text: <We are looking forward to more volumes of study papers and outcomes, especially from other Geneticists who?ve heard this news.>
scripts.translation: <我们期待听闻此事的其他基因学者，也能提交更多研究论文与成果。>

scripts.text:
<Miss. Devries>
<I think that {0} has enough ability and talent to be a Geneticist.>
scripts.translation:
<德弗里斯小姐>
<我认为{0}拥有足够的才能和能力成为一名基因学者。>

scripts.text: <Please tell {0} as soon as possible that we are expecting remarkable activities as a Geneticist from now on.>
scripts.translation: <请尽快告诉{0}，从现在开始，我们期待他作为基因学者展现出非凡的成就。>

scripts.text:
<The Alchemist Union is very proud of Miss Devries, Miss Demi Calberine and {0} who are excellent talented people.>
<We hope that you yield good fruits in the future as well.>
scripts.translation:
<炼金术士公会为德弗里斯小姐、黛米·卡尔贝林以及才华横溢的{0}感到自豪。>
<希望你们未来也能结出丰硕的果实。>

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Congratulations, Popo!
You are a Geneticist from now on!!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
恭喜，波波！
从现在开始，你是一名基因学者了！！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
你正在骑乘坐骑，无法转职。请先解除骑乘状态再试！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Just like the word from the Union, I'm also looking forward to your awesome activities.
Let's try hard together! To become the best Geneticist!
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
正如公会所说，我也很期待你的精彩表现。
让我们一起努力吧！成为最棒的基因学者！

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Popo, do you want to join my Love Orleans club? It's a club for those that love cookies. Of course, we don't think of doing weird things with Charles Orleans.
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
波波，要加入我的“奥尔良之爱”俱乐部吗？
喜欢饼干的人都在这里。
当然，我们可没想着对查尔斯·奥尔良做什么奇怪的事。

scripts.text:
[Devries]
Am I that pretty to you? Why are you staring at me like that?
scripts.translation:
[德弗里斯]
我在你眼里那么漂亮吗？为什么那样盯着我看？

Written by Bob Ross.
scripts.translation:
<世界上最简单的炼金术>
作者：鲍勃·罗斯

scripts.text: Animals
scripts.translation: 动物

scripts.text: Plants
scripts.translation: 植物

scripts.text: Minerals

scripts.translation: 其他

scripts.text:
...Using animals in Alchemy can easily be practiced by anyone.
You can put the animals that you want to use on the white tray, imagine the goal you want to make and then practice the alchemy.
It's very easy.
scripts.translation:
...使用动物进行炼金术，任何人都能轻松上手。
只需将想使用的动物放在白色托盘上，想象想要制作的目标，然后进行炼金术即可。
非常简单。

scripts.text:
...The animals that are used in Alchemy might in the danger of getting extinct because of being captured by thoughtless alchemists.
So I won't mention them.
scripts.translation:
...用于炼金术的动物，可能会因为被无良炼金术士捕捉而面临灭绝的危险。
所以我不打算提及它们。

scripts.text:
...The guide of Alchemy using plants is easy to follow, even for a little kid.
You can put the plants on the table, and break or cut them, connect them using a simple tool, then do alchemy.
That's really an extraordinary method.
scripts.translation:
...使用植物进行炼金术的指南，连小孩子都能轻松看懂。
只需将植物放在桌上，折断或切割它们，用简单的工具连接起来，然后进行炼金术。
这真是一种非凡的方法。

scripts.text: ...The plants usually used for Alchemy are Bigibigi Grass and Muka Trees that have sharp thorns but are delicate inside and Bogi Creeper whose growth speed is really fast but parasitic on living things.
scripts.translation: ...炼金术常用植物包括：大比格草、外皮带有尖刺但内部柔软的摩卡树，以及生长极快、会寄生在生物身上的突变长春藤。

scripts.text:
...Using minerals in Alchemy is a way that beginners find pretty easy.
You can put the minerals you want to in the beautifully crafted box, and sing any song that you can think of twice and then practice the alchemy.
That's really an easy way.
scripts.translation:
...使用矿石进行炼金术，是初学者觉得相当简单的方法。
只需将想使用的矿石放入精美的盒子中，唱两遍你能想到的任何歌曲，然后进行炼金术。
这真的很容易。

scripts.text: ...A mineral that's usually used for Alchemy is 'Phracon' which doesn't cost a lot.
scripts.translation: ...通常用于炼金术的矿石是价格不贵的“强化武器金属-级数一”。

scripts.text:
...Alchemy is the easiest thing in the world.
This writer shows a cobalt blue Alchemy demonstration in front of students every week, and always get a big applaud from them.
I'm sure that you would be into the Alchemy world at the moment you read this book.
scripts.translation:
...炼金术是世上最简单的事。
本书作者每周都会为学生演示钴蓝色的炼金术，总能赢来热烈掌声。
相信翻开这本书的那一刻，你就会迷上炼金术的世界。

Do you want to enter the spore pen?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
唉，你还没练完吗？
你想进入魔菇圈吗？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Hmm~ Where'd that bolt go?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
嗯~ 那颗螺栓跑到哪里去了？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Ah, oh no, oh no~~~
Did you find the parts? No, not yet? You promised, please hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
啊，糟糕，糟糕~~~
你找到零件了吗？还没有吗？你答应过我的，请快点！

scripts.text: [Demi Calberine]
scripts.translation: [黛米·卡尔贝林]

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
It seem Miss Devries found out that I put you in her spore pen.
It's funny when you look at her face. After you've killed all those spores.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
看来德弗里斯小姐发现，是我把你送进她的魔菇圈了。
等你清完那些魔菇，她的表情肯定很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Er~ Where's the bolt?
Why aren't their enough screws? Didn't I order new ones just recently?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
嗯~ 螺栓在哪里？
为什么螺丝不够用？我最近不是刚订了一批新的吗？

scripts.text: Hello~?
scripts.translation: 你好~？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Oh, my~?
When did you... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
哦，天哪~？
你什么时候...你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Oh, my god!
Hey! Please help me!
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
哦，我的天！
嘿！请帮帮我！

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
I need to complete and ordered mini cannon today, but I can't find the parts!
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
今天得交一门订制微型炮，可零件找不到了！

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Ugh~ I think they dropped around here somewhere.
I only need 10! I need to put the other parts together first... Please could you help me?!
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
唉~ 我想它们掉在附近某个地方了。
我只需要10个！我得先把其他零件组装起来...你能帮帮我吗？！

scripts.text: I've got the parts.
scripts.translation: 我找到零件了

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Oh, gosh!
You scared me to death!!
Oh, are these my lost screws and bolts?
Where did you find these?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
哦，天哪！
你吓死我了！！
哦，这些是我丢失的螺丝和螺栓吗？
你在哪里找到这些的？

scripts.text: You asked me to find them!
scripts.translation: 是你让我找的！

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Oh?, really?
Did I? Hohohohoho.
I don't even know where my mind is.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
哦？真的？我说过吗？呵呵呵呵。
瞧我，忙得脑子都乱了。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Please wait a moment.
I will be done quickly with these.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
请稍等。
我会很快把这些弄好的。

scripts.text: - Snap Snap Snap -
scripts.translation: - 咔哒 咔哒 咔哒 -

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Okay, I've connected the cannon to the cart... Now shall we test the performance?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
好了，我已经把大炮装到手推车上了...
现在我们来测试一下性能吧？

scripts.text: - Sizlle... -
- Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop! -
scripts.translation: - 砰！砰！砰！砰！-

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Great! Success!
Whew. You've been a lot of help to me.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
太棒了！成功了！
呼。真是帮了我大忙呢。
非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Oh, by the way what made you come here?
Did you come here to order something
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
哦，对了，你为什么会来这里呢？
是来订购什么东西的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm a Geneticist applicant.
I heard that you were very knowledgeable about portable mini cannons and stuff.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是来申请转职基因学者的，听说你很擅长便携式微型火炮之类的技术。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Yep, I deal with many kinds of cannons.
Nowadays, there are those who want to remodel their carts, so I've been installing several additional functions such as mini cannons to their carts.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
没错，各式各样的火炮我都做。
最近想改良手推车的人很多，我就帮他们加装微型炮等各种新功能。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cart remodeling?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
手推车改良？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Yes, didn't you want to race out when you went downhill?
Or haven't you ever thought that it was so boring dragging around that plain old cart?
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
是的，难道你下坡的时候不想冲出去吗？
或者你从来没想过拖着那辆普通的手推车很无聊吗？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Carts are no longer just a wagon for storage.
You could hang a cannon on a cart to make it help you boost your attack power.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
手推车可不只是载货用的了，装上大炮，还能帮你增强火力。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Miss Devries seems to be studying childish experiments downstairs.
I don't understand why those research papers get so popular.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
德弗里斯小姐似乎正在楼下研究一些幼稚的实验。
我不明白为什么那些研究论文会那么受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
See this mini-mini cannon.
This is the smallest and the lightest cannon in the world.
This is what I made but isn?t this so cute? Yipee~
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
看这门迷你迷你大炮。
这是世界上最小的、也是最轻的大炮。
这是我做的，是不是非常可爱？耶~

scripts.text: Can I get my cart remodeled?
scripts.translation: 我可以改良我的手推车吗？

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Unfortunately, the cart remodeling is only allowed for Geneticists.
It's a rule from the Alchemist Union, so I can't help it.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
很遗憾，手推车改良只允许基因学者使用。
这是炼金术士公会的规定，我也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
But don't get disappointed.
You can be a Geneticist too!
Hohoho.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
但别失望。
你也可以成为基因学者！
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
And what's more, you can?t so the cart remodeling to just any cart.
It can only be done on quality certified carts that've been polished for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
而且，你不能对任何手推车进行改良。
只能对经过长时间打磨、获得质量认证的手推车进行改良。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
You should practice your cart skills whenever you have time until you become a Geneticist.
Till your muscles are dealing with your cart in powerful harmony and your cart moves beautifully,
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
转职基因学者之前，有空就练练手推车技能吧。
要练到身体与车子配合默契，挥动起来得心应手...

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
If you want, ^FF0000I'll show you a good training spot.^000000
^FF0000Devries won't like it much^000000, but it's the best place. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
愿意的话，^FF0000我带你去个练习的好地方。^000000
^FF0000德弗里斯可不会高兴^000000，不过那里最合适，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
How about you swing your cart around as practice?
When you swing your cart at least ^FF0000100^000000 times, you can get rid of stress and the cart will be polished up enough.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
挥动手推车练练吧！
至少挥^FF0000100^000000次，既能减压，也能把车子练顺手。

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Well, I need to get to work for the next order.
Come and find me whenever you need training.
I'll help you out whenever you need your cart remodeled.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
好了，我需要去处理下一个订单了。
需要训练时，随时来找我。
需要改良手推车时，我也会帮你。

scripts.text: - Rattle -
scripts.translation: - 哐当 -

scripts.text: - What's this? I feel like the floor is missing somewhere. -
scripts.translation: - 这是什么？感觉地板好像缺了一块。-

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
Have fun swinging your cart around~
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
尽情挥舞你的手推车吧~

scripts.text:
[Demi Calberine]
What a shame! I wanted to see Miss Devries's angry face.
scripts.translation:
[黛米·卡尔贝林]
真可惜！我本来还想看看德弗里斯小姐生气的样子呢。

scripts.text: - There are so many scattered things on the floor that the lab is in chaos. -
scripts.translation: - 地上散落着许多东西，实验室一片狼藉。-

scripts.text: - You found a little metal fragment. -
scripts.translation: - 你发现了一块金属破片。-

scripts.text: - I think I've gathered all of the parts. -
scripts.translation: - 我想我已经收集齐所有的零件了。-

scripts.text:
= Warning =
If you bully my spores, I'll scream!!!
scripts.translation:
= 警告 =
如果你欺负我的魔菇，我会尖叫的！！！

scripts.text: Get out of the pen.
scripts.translation: 离开围栏

scripts.text: Stay still.
scripts.translation: 保持静止

scripts.text: - I'd better get out before I get caught by Miss Devries. -
scripts.translation: - 我最好在被德弗里斯小姐抓到之前离开这里。-

scripts.text: - I decide to stay still. -
scripts.translation: - 我决定保持静止。-

scripts.text: - 'Monthly Bang!' magazines are piled up in disorder. -
scripts.translation: - 《砰！月刊》杂志杂乱地堆在一起。-

scripts.text: - A checker patterned blanket set which looks like it was picked carefully is too good for this dirty bed. -
scripts.translation: - 这套看起来精心挑选的格纹毯子，放在这张脏床上简直太可惜了。-

scripts.text: < Do you want to have my pretty room? Do you have enough zeny? Is there enough room? Run to the Lighthalzen Department Store right away and get the most high-end wall papers and interior accessories! >
scripts.translation: < 想要拥有我这样漂亮的房间吗？你有足够的Zeny吗？有足够的空间吗？快去里希塔乐镇百货商店，选购最高端的壁纸和室内装饰品！ >

scripts.text: < Luxurious candles that'll lighten up your room, a huge golden mirror that every lady owns, you cannot miss any of them! >
scripts.translation: < 能照亮房间的奢华蜡烛，每位女士都拥有的巨大金边镜子，你绝对不能错过它们！ >

scripts.text: - It's a room that looks like a storehouse, thanks to so many parcels piled up in the room. -
scripts.translation: - 房间里堆满了包裹，看起来像个仓库。-
